annotations.title: Download one signed file of an offer as a PDF. Requires creator or admin access.

description: Download one signed file of an offer as a PDF. file_id is required: this tool returns one file per call, up to 3 MB. Get the IDs from `yardstick_offers_signed_files_list`. For a larger file, or to save every file, use the CLI `yardstick offers signed-files download`. Requires creator or admin access.
name: yardstick_offers_signed_files_download
title: Download one signed file of an offer as a PDF. Requires creator or admin access.
